intent_en: To persuade viewers that the world is becoming more peaceful over the long term, encouraging support for peace and democracy despite current conflicts.
previous_intent: To illustrate the long-term decline in battle deaths per million people, supporting the argument that global violence has decreased and the world is becoming more peaceful over time.
chart_support: Area chart showing battle deaths per year per million people from 1850 to 2000, displaying a general downward trend in violence over time.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly claims that 'things are getting better' and advocates for peace. The chart visualizes 'Battle deaths per year/million people' from 1850 to 2000, showing a significant overall decline in fatalities, which supports the claim that violence is decreasing.
